title: Binance Options Will List BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT 2024-11-08 Expiry Options
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Options will do a one-off early listing of BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT Options with expiry date of 2024-11-08, on  2024-07-24  at  08:00 (UTC).  Please note:   2024-11-08 Expiry Options are European-style options contracts. Please refer to  Binance Options Contract Specifications  for more details.  There may be discrepancies in the translated version of this original article in English. Please reference this original version for the latest or most accurate information where any discrepancies may arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2024-07-23
